opportunities.point: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 guideline of pre-sales ranging from INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

opportunities.point: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

opportunities.point: Three new projects were added during the quarter: Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans to launch four projects in the second half of the year: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

opportunities.point: Mumbai remains India's largest housing market with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018.

opportunities.point: Demand is largely driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

opportunities.point: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 stood at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Delighted to share that we recorded pre-sales for the quarter at INR470 crores, up 83% year-on-year." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

opportunities.point: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

threats.point: The business consumed cash from operations in the latest year.
Profit is growing while operating cash flow is shrinking - an earnings-quality gap.
threats.evidence: Net profit 243 -> 305 Cr (TTM) but operating cash flow -20 Cr (Mar 2025) -> -326 Cr (Mar 2026)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
Promoter selling is a warning about insider conviction.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, which is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)

threats.point: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict." (concall ppt - 2026-10-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun) are still in the cycle.
